items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: We hired him to work with us in Wells's place.

ctx.x: What happened to him? Did he leave California?

I'm gonna tell you about him. And so, we...uh ...I'm working down here. We came down here in '17, and Wells was drafted, and he...they took him to war, so that time, we put Ernest Coycault--you know who he is--Ernest Johnson, the trumpet player with the Black and Tan. We hired him to work with us in Wells's place. Then we...I got a letter here someplace...they wanted us in Honolulu at the...at the...uh...that big hotel over there...can't think of it now. Anyway, after we stayed our time down here--I think it was…
